story_text: As a user, I want logging out twice in a row to not cause an error so that the logout action is idempotent.

positive.title: Return success response for repeated logout requests
steps: 1. Log in to the system with valid credentials.
3. Click on the logout button again.
positive.expected_result: The system should return a success response for the second logout request without causing an error.

negative.title: Return error on second logout attempt
steps: 1. Log in to the system with valid credentials.
3. Click on the logout button again.
negative.expected_result: The system should return an error message indicating that the user is already logged out.

edge.title: Logout twice rapidly in succession
steps: 1. Log in to the system with valid credentials.
2. Click on the logout button twice rapidly.
edge.expected_result: The system should handle the rapid successive logout requests without causing an error.

edge.title: Logout after session already expired
steps: 1. Log in to the system with valid credentials.
2. Wait for the session to expire.
edge.expected_result: The system should handle the logout request gracefully even though the session has expired.

edge.title: Logout under unstable network conditions
steps: 1. Log in to the system with valid credentials.
edge.expected_result: The system should handle the logout request gracefully under unstable network conditions.
